description:
## Goal
Make KinVue operable with Prometheus metrics on every service and Grafana dashboards.

## Scope
HTTP + WS metrics, Prometheus scrape config, Overview/Rooms/Media dashboards, observability runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not change business logic — instrumentation and dashboards only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-611: Prometheus metrics for all services (HTTP + Rooms WS metrics)
2. KIN-612: Grafana dashboards: Overview, Rooms, Media
3. KIN-613: Write `docs/runbooks/observability.md`

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Harden KinVue against common attacks: validation, CORS, rate limits, CI scanning, security tests.

## Scope
Body limits, CORS allowlist, secret/dependency scanning, security test suite, security runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not add new features — hardening only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-621: Input validation + body size limits on all external endpoints
2. KIN-622: CORS allowlist, secret scanning, dependency scanning in CI
3. KIN-623: Security tests: private room denial, viewer playback denial, admin guard, expired JWT, upload type denial
4. KIN-624: Write `docs/runbooks/security.md`

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Convert uploaded originals to multi-bitrate HLS in MinIO via FFmpeg and update movie status.

## Scope
Queue `media.transcode`, FFmpeg worker, internal callbacks, retry logic, fixture test.

## Out of scope
Do not build upload UI or signed URL playback in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-521: RabbitMQ queue `media.transcode` + job schema
2. KIN-522: FFmpeg worker: download original, generate HLS 1080p/720p/480p, upload to MinIO
3. KIN-523: Internal callbacks: transcode-complete → READY, transcode-failed → PROCESSING_FAILED
4. KIN-524: Retry up to 3 attempts before failure
5. KIN-525: Fixture video test: verify playable HLS output

- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Let users schedule future watch sessions that auto-open Redis rooms and notify invitees.

## Scope
`scheduled_rooms` table, CRUD, scheduler, web UI, tests.

## Out of scope
Do not redesign room WebSocket protocol in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-601: `scheduled_rooms` table + CRUD endpoints
2. KIN-602: Scheduler opens Redis room when due + emits invites
3. KIN-603: Schedule watch UI on movie detail + scheduled rooms page
4. KIN-604: Tests: create, cancel, due open, invitee notification

## Goal
Comprehensive automated coverage of user journeys, failure modes, and load baselines.

## Scope
20 E2E journeys, failure tests, load scripts, capacity documentation.

## Out of scope
Do not change production architecture — test and measure only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-701: E2E suite: all 20 user journeys from implementation plan Phase 29
2. KIN-702: Failure tests: Gateway/Auth/Users/Rooms/Redis/Meilisearch/RabbitMQ/transcode scenarios
3. KIN-703: Load test scripts: Gateway, search, Rooms WS, chat, notifications, media
4. KIN-704: Document capacity results in `docs/runbooks/capacity-results.md`

- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Deploy KinVue MVP to production within <= $300/month with smoke-tested Gateway, WS, and media.

## Scope
Production Dockerfiles, infra provisioning, deploy, migrations, deployment runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not target 100k concurrent users — MVP scale only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-711: Production Dockerfiles + env documentation
2. KIN-712: Provision MVP infra (DBs, Redis, RabbitMQ, object storage, CDN) within <= $300/month budget
3. KIN-713: Deploy services + run migrations + smoke tests
4. KIN-714: Write `docs/runbooks/deployment.md`

## Goal
Finalize docs, run acceptance checklist, and tag `v0.1.0-mvp` release.

## Scope
README/plan updates, Phase 34 checklist, git tag.

## Out of scope
Do not start v2 features — documentation and release only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-721: Update README, implementation plan references, open questions, data models
2. KIN-722: Final acceptance checklist (Phase 34) — all FR/NFR verified
3. KIN-723: Tag release `v0.1.0-mvp`

## Goal
Serve HLS only through short-lived signed URLs — never proxy video bytes through app services.

## Scope
`POST /movies/:id/media-access`, web player integration, security tests.

## Out of scope
Do not add DRM, multi-CDN, or a separate streaming service.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-531: `POST /movies/:id/media-access` — auth required, READY/PUBLISHED only, 10 min signed URL
2. KIN-532: Web player requests media-access before HLS load
3. KIN-533: Tests: unauthorized, expired URL, wrong state, successful playback
4. KIN-534: Verify app services never proxy video bytes
